verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a cloud-hosted, always-on agent that keeps memory. However, the evidence documents no retention settings, no way to delete memory or conversations, and no data-deletion capability. The dot keeps its own notes (dots-docs-23) and password saving is optional (dots-docs-17), but these are adjacent behaviors, not user-controlled retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
